messages:
Alice Wong: RC candidate built: `rc-2026-03-19-1`
Alice Wong: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-releases/rc-2026-03-19-1/ (sha: `f4c3b2a9`)
Alice Wong: pin list created, changeset: https://phab/revision/12345
Alice Wong: Change window 03/19 23:00-00:30 UTC, requesting sign-off for canary -> promote plan

Ben Thompson: Quick question — what are the canary targets? latency/cost safe gates?

Alice Wong: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 10m, 20% for 15m, then 100% if stable. Gates: 99th p50 p95 latency < 1.2x baseline, error rate delta < 0.2%, token cost within 5% expected.
Alice Wong: rollout config snippet:
```
rollout: rc-2026-03-19-1
steps:
  - pct: 5
    duration: 10m
  - pct: 20
    duration: 15m
  - pct: 100
```

Carla Nguyen: Added release notes draft: https://docs/internal/releases/rc-2026-03-19-1.md
Carla Nguyen: Calling out model-quant config change and prefix-cache tweak — please review

deploy-bot: Build `rc-2026-03-19-1` verified: artifacts signed, smoke tests passed (10/10).
deploy-bot: /canary start rc-2026-03-19-1 target=canary-group-1 pct=5 duration=10m

Ben Thompson: srep-checks? @sre-oncall can you watch the canary and confirm no perf regressions?

sre-oncall: On it, will monitor latency, oom, and infra errors. Setting dashboard alerts to 1.1x baseline for p95 and 1.3x for p99.

sre-oncall: noticing a small p95 bump, ~1.05x, p99 at 1.12x, error rate steady. continuing to watch. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary step complete: pct=5 duration=10m status=ok
deploy-bot: advancing to pct=20 duration=15m

Dmitri Ivanov: FYI saw a spike in KV cache miss rate at minute 6 of canary, investigating. Not seeing increased user-facing errors yet.

sre-oncall: KV miss spike correlated with a single instance restart, not rollout-wide. keeping green for now.

deploy-bot: Canary step complete: pct=20 duration=15m status=ok

Ben Thompson: Any objections to promoting to prod now? We should pin version in prod manifests before cutover. Command I plan: `rc promote --to prod --pin rc-2026-03-19-1`

Carla Nguyen: Release notes approved. Security reviewed the KMS key change. Go for prod if SRE still good.

Dmitri Ivanov: Agree. Rollback plan: immediate traffic shift to previous `rc-2026-03-12-5` and trigger hotfix branch `hotfix/cache-fix` if errors > 0.5% in 5m or p99 > 1.4x baseline.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll run the rollback playbook step-by-step and hold the pager. thresholds set.

Alice Wong: Promoting now. Doing pin in manifests and kicking the promotion job.
Alice Wong: `kubectl set image -n inference deployment/serving runtime=registry/redwood:rc-2026-03-19-1 --record`

deploy-bot: Promotion started: rc-2026-03-19-1 -> prod
deploy-bot: Orchestrating: updating envs [prod-us, prod-eu], draining canary nodes after warmup

sre-oncall: Watching infra. Initial traffic cutover at 6% and ramping. so far ok.

deploy-bot: Promotion progress: prod-us 35% done, prod-eu 40% done

sre-oncall: Seeing small latency increase p95=1.08x but error rate still within threshold.

Dmitri Ivanov: Cache miss trend flattened after warmup. no action needed.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: all prod clusters updated. status=success

Alice Wong: Promoted and pinned in manifests: `prod-manifests@sha: f4c3b2a9`
Alice Wong: Notifying downstream teams and updating release tracker

Carla Nguyen: :tada: Great work team. Adding badge to release notes and marking RC as released.
